name: Leena Thomas
bio: Photographer working in architecture, interiors, hospitality and travel photography.
artist_vibe_summary: Leena Thomas demonstrates a polished architectural and interior photography style characterized by precise geometric framing, sharp structural focus, and a sophisticated balance of natural and ambient lighting. Her technical execution expertly highlights material textures and spatial depth across modern commercial properties, hospitality spaces, and travel destinations.
